title: fix(insights): remove bindEvent
body:
bindEvent is no longer handled in the component since #6403 (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6403/files#diff-e7717d55fdbbc94c7dd996f78b6f0f860332545d6fa8f6b843c940798334532cL94), so it's removed in this PR.

[FX-3191]

BREAKING CHANGE: the `bindEvent` related functions are non longer usable, use `sendEvent` instead
